items.name: Meeting notes to action plan
items.description: Turn pasted meeting notes into decisions, owners, open questions and a follow-up draft.
items.author: Principia

items.name: Weekly company review
items.description: Bring your weekly updates together into a company brief with blockers and next steps.
items.author: Principia

items.name: Customer conversation follow-up
items.description: Find unanswered customer requests and prepare a reply for your review.
items.author: Principia

items.name: Meeting action planner
items.description: Extract decisions, owners and follow-ups from meeting notes.
items.author: Principia

items.name: Customer context brief
items.description: Summarize the customer situation before a call or handoff.
items.author: Principia

items.name: Launch readiness review
items.description: Check a launch plan for gaps, dependencies and clear ownership.
items.author: Principia

items.name: Generate an image (fal)
items.description: Turns an idea into a detailed prompt and renders it with fal.ai FLUX. The PNG lands in Artifacts.
items.author: Principia

items.name: Generate an image (OpenAI)
items.description: Renders an image with OpenAI gpt-image-1 and saves it to Artifacts.
items.author: Principia

items.name: Product photo studio
items.description: Turns a product photo or a description into up to 4 e-commerce shots (white background, lifestyle, flat lay) with fal.ai FLUX. Can remove the background first. Images land in Artifacts.
items.author: Principia

items.name: Ad creative variants
items.description: Writes 4 Meta/Instagram ad angles (copy + visual concept) from your offer, audience and brand colors. It then renders a square and a vertical image for each angle with fal.ai FLUX, 8 images in all. The images and the copy deck land in Artifacts.
items.author: Principia

items.name: Instagram carousel
items.description: Plans a 5-slide carousel (hook, 3 value slides, CTA) from a topic and brand voice, renders matching 4:5 backgrounds with fal.ai FLUX and writes the caption with hashtags. Everything lands in Artifacts.
items.author: Principia

items.name: Brand kit starter
items.description: From a business name and vibe, proposes 3 logo directions, renders 3 logo marks and a moodboard with fal.ai FLUX (4 images), builds a color palette and writes brand-kit.md to Artifacts.
items.author: Principia

items.name: YouTube thumbnails
items.description: Turn a video title (and an optional face or product photo) into 3 high-contrast 16:9 thumbnails with fal.ai FLUX, then pick the best.
items.author: Principia

items.name: Landing page hero images
items.description: Reads a landing page URL or description, derives one visual direction, and renders wide hero images plus 3 feature illustrations in a consistent style with fal.ai FLUX. PNGs and a README land in Artifacts.
items.author: Principia

items.name: Edit and upscale an image
items.description: Applies a plain-language edit to an image with fal.ai FLUX Kontext, then upscales it 2x or 4x with ESRGAN. Before, edited and upscaled images land in Artifacts.
items.author: Principia

items.name: Local business photo pack
items.description: A matching set of four photos for a local business (interior, service in action, team-style shot, seasonal promo) for Google Business Profile and social, made with fal.ai FLUX. PNGs and a README land in Artifacts.
items.author: Principia

items.name: Scrape a site to Markdown (Firecrawl)
items.description: Scrapes a URL with Firecrawl, saves the Markdown to Artifacts and summarizes it.
items.author: Principia

items.name: Competitor research brief
items.description: Reads a competitor's site with Firecrawl and writes a one-page positioning brief.
items.author: Principia

items.name: Fix a bug, tests must pass
items.description: An agent fixes the bug; a check runs your test command and sends it back until the tests pass.
items.author: Principia

items.name: Code review: Claude + Codex
items.description: Claude and Codex review your uncommitted changes together and agree on the real problems.
items.author: Principia

items.name: Run an Apify actor
items.description: Runs any Apify actor with your APIFY_API_KEY and saves the dataset to Artifacts. Python, no agent.
items.author: Principia

items.name: Resize images in a folder
items.description: Shrinks every image in a folder with macOS sips; copies land in Artifacts. Shell, no installs.
items.author: Principia

items.name: Fetch a JSON API
items.description: GETs a JSON endpoint, optionally with a key from Principia › Keys, and saves the response. Node.
items.author: Principia

items.name: Code reviewer
items.description: Claude Code subagent that reviews a diff for real bugs with file:line and a failing scenario.
items.author: Principia

items.name: Test writer
items.description: Claude Code subagent that writes focused tests in your project's existing style.
items.author: Principia

items.name: Screenshot critic
items.description: Claude Code subagent that critiques UI screenshots and gives exact visual fixes.
items.author: Principia

items.name: Firecrawl
items.description: Teaches Claude to scrape, crawl and search the web with your FIRECRAWL_API_KEY.
items.author: Principia

items.name: fal.ai images
items.description: Teaches Claude to generate images with fal.ai FLUX using your FAL_KEY.
items.author: Principia

items.name: Screenshot to code
items.description: Rebuild a UI from a dropped screenshot using your project's own components.
items.author: Principia
